name: esarr
description: ESARR — the full Array surface (ES3 built-ins + ES5 + ES6+ additions) for Adobe ExtendScript (ES3), engine-measured, spec-exact, with a native ExternalObject acceleration gate (ESARRArray.dll) and espack self-extracting accel bundle

scripts.estc:static: node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESARR.jsx --no-target && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/vendor-esarr.js --no-target && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESARR-runtime.jsx --no-target && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/vendor-esarr-runtime.js --no-target && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESARR.facade.jsx --no-target && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESARR.accel.jsx --no-target && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESARR.accel.min.jsx --no-target
scripts.estc:live-parse: node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESARR.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/vendor-esarr.js --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESARR-runtime.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/vendor-esarr-runtime.js --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESARR.facade.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESARR.accel.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESARR.accel.min.jsx --no-target --live --launch
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build:accel && npm run test && npm run fuzz && npm run estc:static && npm run vendor-sync-check
scripts.release:gate: npm run verify && npm run estc:live-parse && npm run live-verify && npm run accel-e2e
